stories.title: Gaza: Board of Peace and Rebuilding

updates.summary: Board of Peace signed at Davos. 20+ countries. Charter does not mention Gaza. $1B for permanent membership. Kushner presented 'New Gaza' plan - waterfront skyscrapers, luxury developments. Trump called it 'Riviera of the Middle East'. UK, France, Germany, Italy, Canada absent.

spins.white_house: Path to hope and dignity for Gazans

updates.summary: NEW: 35 countries now signed. Putin was invited - UK cited this as reason for declining. Slovenia PM declined saying it 'dangerously interferes with broader international order'. Executive committee: Rubio, Witkoff, Kushner, Tony Blair, World Bank's Ajay Banga. Nikolay Mladenov as director-general.

pending_questions: Will more European nations join or stay out?

updates.summary: Death toll 71,551+ Palestinians since Oct 2023. 100+ children killed since October ceasefire - roughly one per day. 1 million need emergency shelter. Half of hospitals partially functional.
US officially withdrew Jan 22. All funding terminated. Personnel recalled. Will not pay outstanding dues. WHO cutting 22% staff. Lancet: cuts could cause 14.1 million additional deaths by 2030.

spins.us_govt: Accountability for COVID failures, disproportionate funding burden
spins.health_experts: Weakens US disease intelligence, creates power vacuum

updates.summary: First US-Russia-Ukraine trilateral talks since invasion. Abu Dhabi, Jan 23-24. Technical level. Trump envoys met Putin overnight - 4 hours. Key sticking point: territory. Putin demands Kyiv withdraw from annexed areas.

spins.zelensky: Security guarantees finalized, economic deal almost ready

updates.summary: NEW: Talks have commenced. Sheikh Mohamed met delegation heads. Donbas is key issue - Zelensky says unlikely to concede. Putin aide: 'No hope of settlement until territory demands accepted.' Analysts see 'slightly higher prospect' of moratorium on strikes against civilian/energy infrastructure.

spins.uae: Hope meeting contributes to ending conflict
spins.analysts: More likely moratorium than full peace deal
